Mira (design): Quick design check 12 — thinking about an accessible mini-actions cluster in the trace header: icon-only by default, expandable to show 'Copy trace link' and 'Export JSON'. Mock: https://figma.com/file/mini-actions
Theo (product): Love the density. On mobile can it be a bottom sheet instead of a popover? Header space is too tight.
Sana (eng-ux): Yes. Desktop: icon cluster (link, export, external). Expand inline on focus/hover. Mobile: single ellipsis -> bottom sheet with same CTAs.
Ben (eng-runtime): Note: large exports are background jobs, so UI must surface job state. We'll return export_job_id and a polling endpoint. UI toast should announce progress.
Olivia (accessibility): A11y rules: icon buttons need aria-labels including the trace id, focusable order, and visible focus states. Bottom sheet must trap focus and restore to trigger. Announce export completion via aria-live region.
Mira (design): Microcopy: prefer 'Copy trace link' (explicit) and 'Export JSON' for the file action. Toast after copy: show short link + 'Open' button.
Sana (eng-ux): Interaction nit: collapsing stack frames show "+N"; make that togglable via Enter/Space. Also add a keyboard shortcut to copy link (Ctrl+Shift+C).
Ben (eng-runtime): We'll support short-link redirector and include correlation_ids + stack_summary in export. Expand-all will fetch frames lazily.
Theo (product): Track analytics for action usage (copy vs export vs open external) so we can prioritize.
copybot: Reminder: attach contrast screenshots and keyboard nav test gif to the PR as part of the design checklist.
Mira (design): Action items: Sana to update mocks (desktop + mobile), Olivia to publish a11y checklist, Ben to confirm export_job API and short-link endpoint. Thanks all :thumbsup:
